name: Sticky Hardwood Floors After Cleaning in Everett: What Went Wrong
title-tag: Sticky Hardwood Floors After Cleaning — Everett, WA Fixes
meta-description: Sticky hardwood after mopping? It’s almost always polish buildup, oil soap, or overdosed cleaner — not a bad floor. An Everett contractor’s diagnosis and fixes.
post-summary: January 1, 2027 · A sticky floor is almost never under-cleaned — it’s over-treated. How to tell whether the culprit is acrylic polish buildup, oil soap, or cleaner mixed too strong, the three tests that sort it, and the fix ladder from a proper mop to a $1.99/sq ft screen and recoat.
